WT=../eval-worker
BRANCH=$(git -C "$WT" branch --show-current)
REMOTE=$( cd "$WT" && bash "/plugins/source-control/skills/pull-request/scripts/resolve-remote.sh" --push ) || exit 1

gh pr create --draft --head "$BRANCH" --title 'feat: quote CSV cells' --body-file /tmp/pr-body.md
